strategy_roster.name: Chande Kroll Trend
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_low_prev(low,21) - 3 * atr(high,low,close,10) and close > sma(close,21)
strategy_roster.notes: Prior 21-bar Donchian bounds offset by 3-ATR(10) approximate the documented lower/upper Chande Kroll stops, with SMA(21) trend filtering. Exponential calculation mode, risk-based sizing, and 1560-bar sizing lookback are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: 5 EMA No-Touch Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: A break above the prior candle high with price still touching or crossing below EMA(5) proxies the no-touch setup and breakout. Stateful setup-candle extremes, the 3R target, and opposite-extreme stop are not percentage/DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Snowieso
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(10)/EMA(30) and MACD(12,26,9) are explicit fallbacks for the unnamed LWMA and KAMA trend confirmations. LWMA, KAMA, adaptive periods, and absolute point protection are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: GG-RSI-CCI
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) smoothing with SMA(3)/SMA(9) and EMA(5)/EMA(10) price alignment are explicit fallbacks for the missing CCI and parameter values. CCI, flat-mode neutral exits, platform protection, and short entries are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: SilverTrend CrazyChart
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20)/EMA(40) is a rolling current/delayed-band proxy for the custom SilverTrend crossover. The indicator buffers, SignalBar state, point stops/targets, and short branch are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Professional ORB
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 20-bar high break is a rolling opening-range breakout proxy, with the opposite low break as exit. The 09:15 session range, ATR stop, fixed target, daily trade limit, and session close are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Realtime Delta Volume Action
strategy_roster.notes: Volume delta is unavailable, so normalized volume_ratio(20) above 2 is the explicit activity breakout proxy and a return below average exits. The documented 100-unit delta threshold, stop, and opposite signal are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Market Capture
strategy_roster.notes: A rising one-bar ROC while price is below SMA(20) is a state-free proxy for a long swing around the moving grid center. Hedge layering, grid spacing, equity milestones, and step-based targets are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Lilith Goes To Hollywood
strategy_roster.notes: Parabolic SAR and pending-order modes are unavailable; EMA(10)/EMA(30) is an explicit direction-cross proxy with the inverse exit. Hedged recovery sizing, manual reference prices, and step-based risk are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Hull MA
strategy_roster.notes: Hull MA is approximated by EMA(9), with positive EMA ROC representing a rising HMA while RSI(14)<30 enters; RSI returning to the neutral zone exits. ATR(14) with a 2x multiplier is a point/volatility stop, not a percentage field, and the short side is omitted.
